units.contents:
[Unit]
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStartPre=-podman kill k3s
ExecStartPre=-podman rm k3s
ExecStart=podman run --rm -it --privileged \
    --volume /etc/rancher:/etc/rancher:z \
    --volume /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server:/var/lib/rancher/k3s/server:z \
    --name k3s \
    --net=host \
    docker.io/rancher/k3s:v1.33.3-k3s1 \
    server
ExecStop=/bin/podman stop k3s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: k3s.service
